summary: The paper describes the fabrication of annular photonic crystals using atomic layer deposition (ALD) and sacrificial etching. The process involves depositing Al2O3 and AlN layers to form the photonic crystal structure, followed by etching to remove the sacrificial layer and achieve precise alignment.
evidence: ALD was chosen for the conformal deposition of Al2O3 and AlN. We have two ALD systems. One is used for Al2O3 deposition, and the other is for AlN deposition. Al2O3 was grown by alternately induced trimethylaluminum (TMA) and H2O into the reaction chamber which was heated at 150 °C under a pressure of 500 mTorr. While AlN was grown by TMA and NH3 pulses at 350 °C under 600 mTorr.
